title: About Obsidian Star
description: Obsidian Star is an Alternative Rock Band based in the Rochester NY area.

items.name: Shane R.
items.bio: Lead singer and primary songwriter. Plays rhythm and lead guitar.

items.name: Bradley W.
items.bio: I am a Fourth-Year Computer Engineering Major. On top of playing Guitar I also play Drums and Oboe, and if I'm not playing music I'm probably playing Guitar Hero, Kingdom Hearts, or Half-Life. My favorite bands include Alter Bridge, Dream Theater, Tremonti, and a lot more.

items.name: Nick L.
items.bio: Low-end foundation and occasional lead lines.

items.name: Noah S.
items.bio: Keeps time and brings the groove.
